results.overview: In a hospital dominated by ego and corruption, an enigmatic but brilliant surgeon arrives — taking on seemingly impossible cases amid fierce opposition.

results.overview: Doctor Chu Jinghong accidentally entered a different world and became the princess of Northern Chu Kingdom. In order to return to the original world as soon as possible, she must face all kinds of difficulties. In the process, she falls in love with the war King Yu Longyuan.
results.name: Little Mad Doctor
